definitions.full: H1221. Betser II. בֶּ֫צֶר ( fortress ) — 1. proper name, of a location city in Reuben (MI בצר ) Deut 4:43 ; Josh 20:8 ; 1Chr 6:63 . 2. proper name, masculine person a descendant of Asher 1Chr 7:37 .
